events.why: back to the nurse after 03.04's scene: turn right and walk into the counter, which faces her; the counter stops the walk, so 2 s is safe.

the nurse heals the party (A takes a question's top answer), until control at the counter. Healing writes the game's own save at the counter, 03.06's start, so the program adds no menu save (it would write the same spot again). UNVERIFIED, NEEDS CONSOLE: the nurse's lines were not recorded.

metadata.source: gives Main Mission 03 a save at the counter to retry from: 03.06's start check looks for it, and falls back to the backup save when the latest is past it. Not recorded yet: every step is unverified
